target_population: all literal path references recorded as absent at their anchor commit with non-null sampling keys
selection_rule: First 130 open_missing and first 252 completed_missing references by pre-evidence random rank within task-status strata.
selection_verification: The frozen 382 records occupied ranks 1 through n in their respective strata before the intermediate candidate draw was retired from the release.
prior_overlap_policy: Retain probabilistically selected overlaps, flag them, and report sensitivity without them; exclusion would change the target population.
